integrity: An explicit all-parameter proof is given; exact integer matrix and independent-set enumeration for d=2..8 corroborate but do not replace proof. No independent certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Geometric half-turn quotient only at cycle length twice the bounded-independence parameter; no statement for all cyclic or dihedral subgroups, longer cycles, Borel quotients, or independent external review.
title: Projective suspensions in half-turn quotients of bounded-independence cycle spheres
